# Release notes: ground-up redesign

Full findings the rebuild answers are in [docs/audit-2026-11.md](docs/audit-2026-11.md) — 38 issues, P0-1 to P3-8.

## What changed

**Architecture.** Every page is now generated by `scripts/build_site.py` from `scripts/site_lib.py`, so the header, footer, schema, metadata and card markup cannot drift between pages. The five stylesheets (56 KB across five blocking requests) became one `css/site.css`; `js/main.js` was rewritten as a single dependency-free file. The old Node asset scripts were removed with the pipeline they served.

**Design.** Dark executive system: obsidian ground, cyan and emerald ambient light, Inter display type, glass surfaces. Verified status pill, dual CTAs ("Request Priority Asset Recovery", "Verify Credentials & Work"), framed portrait with border lighting, bento proof strip (40+ assets recovered, global and domestic retainers, Founder & CEO, verified Google Business Profile). Sticky glass header with a full-width mega-menu anchored to the container and a `max-height` scroll guard, plus an inert-region mobile drawer with focus trap and scroll lock.

**Clients.** A researched grid on the homepage and `/portfolio/`: Sanatorium Tattoo (Edinburgh), I AM BEING (London), Afghan Carpet (UAE/South Asia), Ingram Investments (UK/UAE), NOTFIT, Upseeks Media, PinClever. Each card carries industry, region, the scope badge "Social media security & management" and a `rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"` outbound link.

**Video testimonials.** Four facade cards per page with no iframe on load, a glass play control, a `0:30` badge, client, brand, service tag and quote. Click swaps to `youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<id>?autoplay=1&rel=0`; 9:16 and 16:9 are both supported.

**SEO and knowledge graph.** One `@graph` per page with `"@context": "https://schema.org"` and stable `@id`s (`/#website`, `/#person`, `/#organization`, `/#portrait`, `<path>#webpage`) plus Service, Article, FAQPage, ContactPage, ProfilePage, BreadcrumbList and ItemList nodes. The Person node carries 12 `sameAs` URLs. Unique title, description, canonical, OG and Twitter tags per page; 29 OG cards; image sitemap entries for the primary portrait; `/blog/` authority hub with six long-form guides; `/Atikulislamx/` redirect stub.

**Security and legal.** `_config.yml` keeps `docs/`, `prompts/`, `scripts/`, `design/`, `data/`, `README.md`, `RELEASE.md` and the source photo off the web, and `robots.txt` disallows the same paths. Added `/.well-known/security.txt`, `/privacy-policy/` and `/terms/`. The Dinajpur sentence was rewritten neutrally. Email addresses are base64-assembled in the browser; no `mailto:` exists in the HTML. The contact form pushes a `generate_lead` event to the GTM container `GTM-PHVGHCMT`.

**Tooling.** `scripts/check-site.mjs` now enforces `@context` on every JSON-LD block, resolving `@graph` references, entity presence per page, full OG/Twitter sets, duplicate titles and descriptions, banned copy, email obfuscation and the publishing scope — and it proves the internal documents are excluded. `scripts/preview.py` reproduces the GitHub Pages excludes locally.

## Verified

- `node scripts/check-site.mjs`: **no errors**, 32 HTML files, 29 sitemap URLs, 31 unique titles.
- All 29 sitemap URLs return 200 from the preview server; `/docs/`, `/README.md`, `/scripts/`, `/data/`, `/prompts/`, `/_config.yml` return 404.
- HTML tag balance checked on all 32 pages; no undefined CSS class in any page.
- Copy: zero occurrences of student, junior, fresher, aspiring or "AI-assisted" anywhere.

## Not verified in the sandbox

- Pixel review in a real browser: no Chromium or Playwright available here, so breakpoints were verified by CSS geometry, not by screenshot. Check the homepage at 1024 px, 1280 px and 390 px before announcing.
- Form delivery through Web3Forms and the GTM conversion in Tag Assistant — both need the live site.
- Client permissions and the two named case studies still require the owner's confirmation (see `docs/deployment-checklist.md`).
